title: cyperus strigosus var. stenolepis
intro: Cyperus strigosus var. stenolepis, commonly known as the slender umbrella sedge, is a plant species belonging to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). The health benefits of Cyperus strigosus var. stenolepis include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate respiratory issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
